name: @hivemagnus/magnus
description: Install, upgrade and roll back a Magnus server and console with one command: `npx @hivemagnus/magnus init`, then `magnus upgrade`. Pins exact, tested component versions, backs up PostgreSQL before every migration and reverts automatically when the new version fails its health check.
author: ChefTaco

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_BACKUP_KEEP
newOptionalEnv.description: Dumps kept in MAGNUS_BACKUP_DIR (default 5); the newest of each label always stays.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AUTO_MIGRATE_LOCK_TIMEOUT
newOptionalEnv.description: Seconds auto-migrate waits for another instance's migrate lock (default 600).

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_MIGRATE_DATABASE_URL
newOptionalEnv.description: Direct database connection for migrations, dumps and restores when DATABASE_URL goes through a pooler.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AGENT_REVIEWED_HISTORICAL_RECORDS
newOptionalEnv.description: Path of the root-owned reviewed historical mutation records file (default /etc/magnus/reviewed-historical-records.json).

magnusRelease.summary: Upgrade resilience: console and CLI agent upgrades keep going past refused nodes, survive server restarts and lost replies, and can be stopped and retried; the agent launcher survives full disks, power loss and control-API outages; `magnus upgrade` records interrupted upgrades for resume or rollback, restores into a clean schema, and refuses unsafe rollbacks. No migrations.
